scheme_name: Interest Subvention against long terms loan to the Co-operative sugar societies (Normal Area) (Tribal Area)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a sugar cooperative society that has taken a loan for payment of sugarcane arrears for the 2018‑19 season.
benefits_summary: Interest subvention is provided on the loan amount up to 7% or the actual interest, whichever is lower, for up to 4 years after an initial year funded by the central government.
